data.name: CDRterra
data.pathway_secondary: Afforestation; BECCS; Biochar; Enhanced Weathering; DAC
data.description: CDRterra is a German federal research funding program (BMFTR, formerly BMBF) launched in 2021 that coordinates academic research on land-based carbon dioxide removal methods. It funds interdisciplinary consortia investigating afforestation, BECCS, biochar, enhanced weathering, DACCS, and soil carbon sequestration to inform German climate policy toward 2045 greenhouse-gas neutrality. It is a research program, not a CDR supplier.
